assignments.value: ABC Hospital  About Hospital: ABC Hospital is a multi-specialty healthcare center providing high-quality medical care with experienced doctors, advanced medical facilities, and patient-friendly services. The hospital focuses on fast appointment scheduling, professional treatment, emergency care, and modern diagnostic support.  Hospital Address: ABC Hospital Road No. 12, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana, India  Contact Information: Reception Phone: +91 9876543210 Emergency Helpline: +91 9999999999 Email: support@abchospital.com Website: www.abchospital.com  Hospital Timings: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM  Sunday: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM  Emergency services are available 24/7.  Departments Available: - Orthopedics - Pediatrics - Dermatology - Cardiology - Dentistry - Ophthalmology - General Medicine - Neurology - ENT - Gynecology  Orthopedics Department: Treatment for: - Joint pain - Back pain - Fractures - Sports injuries - Knee replacement - Bone disorders  Doctors: - Dr. Amit Verma - Dr. Neeraj Singh  Pediatrics Department: Treatment for: - Child fever - Vaccination - Child infections - Growth monitoring - General pediatric care  Doctors: - Dr. Priya Nair - Dr. Kunal Sharma  Dermatology Department: Treatment for: - Skin allergy - Acne - Hair fall - Fungal infection - Skin rash  Doctors: - Dr. Sneha Kapoor - Dr. Anjali Shah  Cardiology Department: Treatment for: - High blood pressure - Chest pain - Heart disease - ECG and heart checkup  Doctors: - Dr. Rakesh Mehta - Dr. Vivek Rao  Dentistry Department: Treatment for: - Tooth pain - Root canal - Teeth cleaning - Braces - Dental surgery  Doctors: - Dr. Meera - Dr. Ayush  Facilities Available: - 24/7 Emergency Care - ICU Support - Digital X-Ray - MRI Scan - CT Scan - Ultrasound - Pathology Lab - Pharmacy - Ambulance Service - Cashless Insurance Support - Online Appointment Booking - Wheelchair Accessibility - Parking Facility  Consultation Fees: General Consultation: ₹500  Specialist Consultation: ₹700 to ₹1200 depending on department.  Emergency Consultation: ₹1500  Payment Methods: - Cash - UPI - Credit Card - Debit Card - Net Banking - Insurance  Insurance Support: ABC Hospital accepts: - Star Health - HDFC Ergo - ICICI Lombard - Care Health - Niva Bupa - Aditya Birla Health Insurance  Required Documents: Please bring: - Government ID proof - Previous medical reports - Insurance card (if applicable) - Prescription documents  Appointment Rules: - Patients should arrive 15 minutes before appointment time. - Late arrival may require rescheduling. - Appointment cancellation should be done at least 2 hours before scheduled time. - Emergency patients are prioritized.  Emergency Services: Emergency department is open 24 hours a day.  Available emergency support: - Trauma care - Accident support - Cardiac emergency - Pediatric emergency - Ambulance service  Ambulance Contact: +91 9999999999  Visiting Hours: General Ward: 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM  ICU Visiting: Only one visitor allowed at a time.  Pharmacy Timings: 24/7 Pharmacy available inside hospital.  Parking Information: Free parking available for patients and visitors.  Languages Supported: - English - Hindi - Telugu  Online Services: - Online appointment booking - Email confirmation - SMS reminders - Digital prescriptions - Teleconsultation support  COVID Safety Measures: - Sanitization after every consultation - Mask support available - Hand sanitizers installed across hospital - Separate isolation rooms available  Hospital Mission: To provide affordable, accessible, and patient-friendly healthcare with modern medical technology and compassionate care.
